commit.message:
fix(browser): restore semantic context and quarantine liveness

Two live-proven P0 defects discovered on host 0.7.0-dev.35262471133.1:

D-L4 root cause — Chromium's Runtime.enable is idempotent: re-invoking it
on an already-enabled domain does NOT re-deliver executionContextCreated.
Any document replacement after the persistent CDP pool attached (RELOAD,
redirect, self-refresh, NEW_TAB with its load-time redirect) cleared the
execution-context binding and semantic refs stayed dead forever
(semantic_refs_issued=0 observed live on every navigated tab). Fix:
- documentUpdated re-seed now toggles Runtime.disable -> Runtime.enable
  (the only reliable way to force V8 to report live contexts);
- new bounded, single-flight, rate-limited
  recoverExecutionContextBinding() pool method;
- CAPTURE self-heals the binding before issuing semantic refs.

D-Q1 — a QUARANTINED transaction whose quarantine reason
(session_continuity_auth_required) later healed was a permanent dead end:
the re-probe loop treats QUARANTINED as terminal, BEGIN_ALLOWED_PRIOR_STATES
rejects it, and the updater stayed latched on
unresolved_prior:QUARANTINED until a human ran an installer. Fix:
- journal: guarded QUARANTINED -> SUCCESSOR_BOOTED reopen bound to
  positive metadata-only heal evidence;
- heartbeat qualification: healed auth evidence reopens the exact
  transaction and restarts the re-probe loop;
- supervisor maintenance lane refreshes the latched AUTH_REQUIRED
  continuity projection once a fresh readback classifies AUTHENTICATED;
- recovery diagnostic records the reopen and resumes pending
  qualification.

Tests: 14 new contract tests (toggle semantics, single-flight, rate limit,
capture self-heal, reopen contract, diagnostic recording, heartbeat heal
end-to-end, non-healable reasons, projection refresh); adjacent batteries
335 (334 pass / 1 Windows skip); full suite 2321 tests / 2319 pass /
0 fail / 2 skip; npm run check clean.
